start: Member with the MettleUp watch app, a watch screen diary on the phone, online

steps.action: Open Settings, Help and feedback
user_sees: Switch 'Add my watch's screen log' with the caption about screen times and Battery Saver
must_not: The switch already on

steps.action: Type 'My watch screen goes black', switch the log on, tap 'Send'
user_sees: A note that the message was sent and 'Your watch screen log was sent too.'
must_not: The log sent before the message
Two copies after a double tap

steps.action: Tap the floating feedback button, type a message, switch 'Add my watch's screen log' on, send
user_sees: 'Your watch screen log was sent too.'
must_not: The switch missing from the floating button's sheet when the diary exists

start: Members for whom the log cannot go

steps.action: Open Help and feedback with no watch diary on the phone
must_not: A switch that sends nothing

steps.action: Leave the message empty
must_not: The log sent on its own

steps.action: Send with the log on while the feedback box refuses the log
user_sees: 'Your message was sent, but the watch screen log was not. Try again later.'
must_not: 'sent too' for a log that failed

steps.action: Send with no internet
user_sees: The message's own failure words; no log note
must_not: A log sent after the message failed

steps.action: Switch the log on, then off, then tap 'Send'
must_not: The log sent with the switch off

steps.action: After a sent log, send another message
must_not: The log sent again without the member switching it on

steps.action: Read the caption, send the log
user_sees: Caption: 'It holds only the times your watch screen turned on, off or dim, and your watch's Battery Saver and screen settings.'
must_not: The watch name, a workout's content, heart rate or the gym code in the log
Anything else beyond what the caption names sent without saying so

must_not: Old Feedback message, help question missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Close the app (swipe it away) at step 2 of "'Add my watch's screen log' in Help and feedback", then open it again.
